jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for PawTrail: match the reference's fine textured 2D RPG pixel materials, restrained dark colored outlines, graphite/slate metal, copper edges, small cyan/magenta lights and warm amber work lamps. Top-down three-quarter orthographic game camera with front and top visible, aligned native horizontal/vertical walking axes, not diamond isometric. Clear material divisions, readable at native size; not photoreal or simple vector blocks. No text, letters, HUD, labels, watermark, giant halos, haze, backdrop or cast shadow outside object unless ground explicitly requested. Create ONLY the continuous empty ground/floor layer for the reference's 40×28-tile utility map, 1280×896 intended native area, full opaque landscape. Remove ALL tall structures, doors, machines, railings, containers, reservoirs, characters, effects and terminals from the reference; keep a continuous weathered graphite maintenance floor under their footprints. Broad quiet curving maintenance lane from lower-left around a large central blank machinery footprint toward upper-right, with a west side pocket and upper relay alcove. Sparse authored wet cyan/amber reflections, inset drains and irregular worn panels. No editor lines, checkerboard, repeated square seams, perspective vanishing point or large markings. Floor fills the entire image.

Use case: stylized-concept. PawTrail friendly courier NPC Nyx Tal for the approved Rainline map reference. Exactly SIX full-body normal idle illustration frames in a 3-column ×2-row equal grid on genuine transparent background, complete uncut head-to-boots in every cell, wide transparent gutters. Mature Refined cel + painterly pixel finish, fine dark brown contours, muted textured fabric; no portrait collage or huge glow. Identity consistent throughout: practical woman late twenties, warm medium brown skin, short swept dark charcoal hair tucked behind one ear, steel-gray eyes, no hat or glasses, no default flirtation. Slate-blue short weatherproof coat with muted burgundy seam accents, warm gray high-collar shirt, charcoal full-length trousers, worn brown ankle boots, compact messenger backpack/satchel strapped securely behind her. No long cape, weapon, heels, exaggerated cleavage or armor. Restrained dry professional expression, relaxed standing pose with hands neutral near belt/strap. Calm 4.8-second breathing with anchored feet, subtle coat hem/hair movement. Frame1 eyes open at rest; frame2 half blink; frame3 closed eyelids; frame4 open; frames5/6 subtle settle/recovery. Head/face/feet same registration, no pose walking, no bobbing whole character up/down, no missing lower body. Tiny burgundy accent is clothing, not background.
